name: Map Script
description: Writes war3map.j from the map's data like the World Editor does on save: triggers, variables, regions, cameras, sounds, placed units and destructables, item tables, player and force setup. Runs when one of those files is saved, or on command.

script.generateOnSave.description: Rewrite war3map.j whenever triggers, regions, cameras, sounds, placed objects or map info are saved (Lua maps are left alone).
